speak: Business Number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Line 110. Total undepreciated capital cost of depreciable properties. Total of column 220 from Schedule 8, Capital Cost Allowance (CCA).

Line 112. Charitable donations not yet deducted from income. From line 280 of Schedule 2, Charitable Donations and Gifts. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 114. Gifts to Canada, a province, or a territory. From line 380 of Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 116. Gifts of certified cultural property. From line 480 of Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 118. Gifts of certified ecologically sensitive land. From line 580 of Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 120. Gifts of medicine. From line 680 of Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 122. Cumulative eligible capital. From line 300 of Schedule 10, Cumulative Eligible Capital Deduction.

Line 124. Federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool. From line 470 of Form T661, Scientific Research and Experimental Development (SR&ED) Expenditures Claim. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include the Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool earned before control of the corporation was last acquired.
Line 128. Cumulative Canadian exploration expense. From line 249 of Schedule 12, Resource-Related Deductions. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.
Line 130. Cumulative Canadian development expense. From line 349 of Schedule 12. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.
Line 132. Cumulative Canadian oil and gas property expense. From line 449 of Schedule 12. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.

Line 134. Non-capital losses. Line 102 of Schedule 4, Corporation Loss Continuity and Application, of the current tax year. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include losses that arose before control of the corporation was last acquired.

Line 136. Net capital losses. From line 200 of Schedule 4 of the current tax year multiplied by 50%. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include losses that arose before control of the corporation was last acquired.

Line 150. Total reserves deducted under paragraph 20(1)(l), (l.1), (m), (m.1), (n), or (o), subsection 32(1), section 61.4 or subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii), or (iv) of the federal Act, as it applies for the purposes of the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario).
Line 152. One half of the total reserves deducted under subparagraph 40(1)(a)(iii) or 44(1)(e)(iii) of the federal Act, as it applies under the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario).
Line 154. Other discretionary deductions claimed for Ontario income tax, but not claimed federally in the tax years ending after December 12, 2006, and before the transition time.

Line 160. Total adjusted cost base of partnership interests owned by the corporation, under the federal Act, at the beginning of the tax year. The adjusted cost base of any particular partnership interest cannot be less than 0.

Line 162. Gain from a negative adjusted cost base of a partnership interest under subsection 40(3) of the federal Act, as it applies under the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario), as if all partnership interests were disposed of at the beginning of the tax year.
Line 164. Amount of farming income specified under paragraph 28(1)(b) in the previous tax year.
Amount A. Federal balance before election. Total of lines 110 to 164.
Line 170. Lesser of amount D or amount E from Part 4, if an election is made.
Line 180. Total federal balance. Amount A minus line 170. Enter amount on line 300 in Part 3.
Line 210. Total undepreciated capital cost of depreciable properties. Total of column 13 from Ontario Schedule 8, Ontario Capital Cost Allowance.
Line 212. Charitable donations. Amount I from Ontario Schedule 2, Ontario Charitable Donations and Gifts. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.

Line 214. Gifts to Canada, a province, or a territory. Total of closing balance amounts from parts 3 and 5 of Ontario Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 216. Gifts of certified cultural property. Closing balance amount from Part 6 of Ontario Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 218. Gifts of certified ecologically sensitive land. Closing balance amount from Part 7 of Ontario Schedule 2. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 220. Gifts of medicine. Enter 0 if the corporation was non-resident immediately before its transition time.
Line 222. Cumulative eligible capital. Amount Q from Ontario Schedule 10, Ontario Cumulative Eligible Capital Deduction.

Line 224. Ontario Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool. Line 480 from Ontario CT23 Schedule 161, Ontario Scientific Research and Experimental Development Expenditures. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include the Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool earned before control of the corporation was last acquired.

Line 226. Adjusted Ontario Scientific Research and Experimental Development incentive balance. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. The adjusted Ontario S R and E D incentive balance under subsection 49(7) of the Taxation Act, 2007 Ontario is the total of federal investment tax credits that:;–have been earned and are available without restriction to the corporation;;–are attributable to qualifying Ontario S R and E D expenditures;;– have not been deducted under subsection 127(5) or (6) of the federal Act in a tax year ending prior to the start of the tax year ending immediately before the corporation's transition time.

Line 228. Cumulative Canadian exploration expense. Closing balance of Regular Expenses from Part 2 of Ontario Schedule 12, Ontario Exploration Expenses. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.

Line 230. Cumulative Canadian development expense. Closing balance of Regular Expenses, Canadian Cumulative Canadian Development Expenses, from Part 3 of Ontario Schedule 12. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.

Line 232. Cumulative Canadian oil and gas property expense. Closing balance of Regular Expenses from Part 4 of Ontario Schedule 12. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time.

Line 234. Non-capital losses. From line 709 of Ontario Corporations Tax Return CT8 or CT23 Corporations Tax and Annual Return. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include losses that arose before control of the corporation was last acquired.

Line 236. Net capital losses. From line 719 of CT8 or CT23 multiplied by 50%. Enter 0 if control of the corporation was acquired at transition time. Do not include losses that arose before control of the corporation was last acquired.
Line 250. Total reserves deducted under paragraph 20(1)(l), (l.1), (m), (m.1), (n), or (o), subsection 32(1), section 61.4 or subparagraph 138(3)(a)(i), (ii), or (iv).
Line 252. One half of the total reserves deducted under subparagraph 40(1)(a)(iii) or 44(1)(e)(iii).

Line 260. Total adjusted cost base of partnership interests owned by the corporation, for the purposes of the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario), at the beginning of the tax year. The adjusted cost base of any particular partnership interest cannot be less than 0.
Line 262. Gain from a negative adjusted cost base of a partnership interest under subsection 40(3) determined as if all partnership interests were disposed of at the beginning of the tax year.
Line 264. Amount of farming income in the previous tax year specified under paragraph 28(1)(b) of the federal Act, as it applies for the purposes of the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario).
Line 280. Total Ontario balance. Total of lines 210 to 264. Enter amount on line 340 in Part 3.
Line 300. Total federal balance. Amount from line 180 in Part 1, or amount from line 330 in Part 3 of Schedule 506 for the previous tax year.

Line 310. Amount from eligible amalgamation. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 windup, eligible pre-2009 windup, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 315. Amount from eligible post-2008 winding-up. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 winding-up, eligible pre-2009 winding-up, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 320. Amount from eligible pre-2009 winding-up. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 winding-up, eligible pre-2009 winding-up, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 325. Amount from specified pre-2009 transfers. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 windup, eligible pre-2009 windup, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.
Line 330. Total federal balance at the end of the tax year. Add lines 300, 310, 315, 320, and 325. Instance 1.
Line 330. Amount from Total federal balance at the end of the tax year. Instance 2.
Line 340. Total Ontario balance. Amount from line 280 in Part 2, or amount from line 370 in Part 3 of Schedule 506 for the previous tax year.

Line 350. Amount from eligible amalgamation. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 windup, eligible pre-2009 windup, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 355. Amount from eligible post-2008 winding-up. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 winding-up, eligible pre-2009 winding-up, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 360. Amount from eligible pre-2009 winding-up. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 winding-up, eligible pre-2009 winding-up, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.

Line 365. Amount from specified pre-2009 transfers. See page 1 for definitions of eligible amalgamation, eligible post-2008 windup, eligible pre-2009 windup, and specified pre-2009 transfers. To calculate these amounts, you can use Schedule 507, Ontario Transitional Tax Debits and Credits Calculation.
Line 370. Total Ontario balance at the end of the tax year. Add lines 340, 350, 355, 360, and 365. Instance 1.
Line 370. Amount from Total Ontario balance at the end of the tax year. Instance 2.
Line 390. Transitional balance at the end of the tax year. Line 330 minus line 370.
Line 400. Are you making an election under clause (b) of the definition of I in paragraph 1 of subsection 48(4) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario)? Yes.
Line 400. Are you making an election under clause (b) of the definition of I in paragraph 1 of subsection 48(4) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario)? No.
Amount B. Federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool closing balance at the end of the previous tax year. Amount from line 124 in Part 1.
Part 4. Amount 1. Adjusted Ontario Scientific Research and Experimental Development incentive balance at the end of the previous tax year. Amount from line 226 in Part 2.
Part 4. Amount 2. Ontario Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure pool closing balance at the end of the previous tax year. Amount from line 224 in Part 2.
Amount C. Subtotal. Part 4 amount 1 plus Part 4 amount 2. Instance 1.
Amount C. Amount from Subtotal. Instance 2.
Amount D. Subtotal. Amount B minus amount C. If negative, enter 0.
Federal balance before election. Amount A from Part 1.
Total Ontario balance. Amount from line 280 in Part 2.

Amount E. Subtotal. Federal balance before election amount A from Part 1 minus Total Ontario balance amount from line 280 in Part 2. If negative, enter 0. Enter the lesser of amount D and amount E on line 170 in Part 1.
Line 410. Number of days in the corporation's reference period. Do not include February 29, 2008, and February 29, 2012.
Line 420. Number of days in the amortization period that are in the tax year. Do not include February 29, 2008, or February 29, 2012.

Line 430. The amortization period of the corporation usually coincides with the corporation's reference period. However, if the corporation's amortization period ends in the tax year and before the reference period ends, tick the applicable box below to indicate the reason for the early termination. 1. The corporation ceases to have a permanent establishment in Ontario in the tax year for any reason other than an eligible amalgamation or eligible post-2008 winding-up.
2. The corporation becomes exempt from tax under Part 1 of the federal Act immediately after the end of the tax year.

3. The corporation elects under subsection 47(2) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario) to prepay the transitional tax debit. Note: The Ontario Allocation Factor, calculated in Part 6, has to be at least 90% or the amount on line 390 in Part 3 is not more than $10,000.

4. The corporation does not object to early termination of the amortization period and accelerated payment of the transitional tax credit, under subsection 46(3) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario). Note: Amount T in Part 8 cannot be more than $1,000.

Line 435. If you ticked one of the boxes at line 430, enter the date of the early termination, if the date is different from the tax year end and you ticked box 1 at line 430. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.

Line 440. If you ticked one of the boxes at line 430, enter the number of days from the first day of the tax year to the end of the corporation's reference period. Do not include February 29, 2008, or February 29, 2012.

Ontario taxable income. Enter the amount allocated to Ontario from column F in Part 1 of Schedule 5, Tax Calculation Supplementary – Corporations. If taxable income is nil, calculate the amount in column F as if taxable income were $1,000.
Taxable income. Enter taxable income from line 360 or amount Z of the T2 return, whichever applies. If taxable income is nil, enter 1,000.
Ontario taxable income divided by Taxable income.

Amount F. Ontario allocation factor (OAF). If the provincial or territorial jurisdiction entered on line 750 of the T2 return is Ontario, enter 1 on line F. If the provincial or territorial jurisdiction entered on line 750 of the T2 return is multiple, enter the result of Ontario taxable income divided by Taxable income.
Amount G. Amount from line 390 in Part 3.
Part 7. Ontario basic rate of tax. Enter the rate calculated in Part 1 of Schedule 500, Ontario Corporation Tax Calculation.
Amount H. Amount G multiplied by Ontario basic rate of tax.
Amount I. Amount H multiplied by Ontario allocation factor amount from line F in Part 6.
Part 7. Number of days from line 440 (if applicable) or line 420 in Part 5.
Part 7. Number of days in the corporation's reference period from line 410 in Part 5.
Amount J. Part 7 Number of days from line 440 or line 420 in Part 5 divided by Part 7 Number of days in the corporation's reference period.
Amount K. Transitional tax debit before tax on elected reduced Scientific Research and Experimental Development pool. Amount I multiplied by amount J.
Line 460. Post 2008 Scientific Research and Experimental Development balance at the end of the year. Amount HH from Part 12.
Line 470. Federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development transitional balance at the end of the year. Amount QQ from Part 14.
Amount L. Tax on elected reduced Scientific Research and Experimental Development pool. The lesser of lines 460 and 470.
Amount M. Total transitional tax debits. Amount K plus amount L. Enter amount M on line 276 of Schedule 5.
Amount N. Amount C6 from Schedule 5.
Ontario resource tax credit. From line 404 of Schedule 5.
Ontario tax credit for manufacturing and processing. From line 406 of Schedule 5.
Ontario foreign tax credit. From line 408 of Schedule 5.
Ontario credit union tax reduction. From line 410 of Schedule 5.
Amount O. Subtotal. Ontario resource tax credit plus Ontario tax credit for manufacturing and processing, Ontario foreign tax credit, and Ontario credit union tax reduction. Instance 1.
Amount O. Amount from subtotal. Instance 2.
Amount P. Subtotal. Amount N minus amount O.
Part 8. Number of days from line 420 in Part 5.
Part 8. Number of days in the tax year. Do not include February 29, 2008, or February 29, 2012.
Amount Q. Part 8 Number of days from line 420 in Part 5 divided by Part 8 Number of days in the tax year.
Line 510. Ontario tax payable for purposes of the current year transitional tax credit. Amount P multiplied by amount Q.
Amount R. Amount from line 390 in Part 3. Enter as a positive amount.
Part 8. Ontario basic rate of tax. Enter the rate calculated in Part 1 of Schedule 500, Ontario Corporation Tax Calculation.
Amount S. Amount R multiplied by Ontario basic rate of tax.
Amount T. Amount S multiplied by Ontario allocation factor amount from line F in Part 6.
Part 8. Number of days from line 440 (if applicable) or line 420 in Part 5.
Part 8. Number of days in the corporation's reference period from line 410 in Part 5.
Amount U. Part 8 Number of days from line 440 if applicable or line 420 in Part 5 divided by Part 8 Number of days in the corporation's reference period from line 410 in Part 5.
Line 520. Current-year transitional tax credit. Amount T multiplied by amount U.
Line 530. Ontario tax payable for purposes of the unused transitional tax credit carryforward. Line 510 minus line 520. If negative, enter 0.
Amount V. Lesser of amounts on line 510 and 520.
Amount W. Lesser of unused transitional tax credit available amount Y from Part 9 and amount on line 530.
Amount X. Transitional tax credits. Amount V plus amount W. Enter amount X on line 414 of Schedule 5.
Part 9. Amount 1. Unused transitional tax credit carryforward from previous year. Amount from line 580 of the previous year. Enter 0 if this is the first tax year ending after 2008.

Line 560. Part 9. Amount 2. Unused transitional tax credit transferred from a predecessor corporation or a subsidiary on an eligible amalgamation or an eligible post 2008 winding-up. Enter 0 if this is the first tax year ending after 2008.
Amount Y. Unused transitional tax credit available. Part 9 amount 1 plus part 9 amount 2. Instance 1.
Amount Y. Amount from Unused transitional tax credit available. Instance 2.
Amount Z. Current-year transitional tax credit. Amount from line 520 in Part 8.
Part 9. Amount 3. Subtotal. Amount Y plus amount Z.
Amount AA. Transitional tax credit applied. Amount X from Part 8.
Line 580. Unused transitional tax credit. Available for later years. Part 9 amount 3 minus amount AA.
Line 610. Current Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditures in the year under paragraph 37(1)(a).
Line 614. Capital Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditures in the year under paragraph 37(1)(b).
Line 618. Repayment of assistance under paragraph 37(1)(c).
Line 624. Investment tax credit recaptured under subsections 127(27), (29), and (34) in the previous tax year.
Amount BB. Subtotal 1. Total of lines 610, 614, 618, and 624. Instance 1.
Amount BB. Amount from Subtotal 1. Instance 2.
Line 638. Assistance under paragraph 37(1)(d).
Line 644. Investment tax credits deducted under paragraph 37(1)(e).
Amount CC. Subtotal 2. Line 638 plus line 644. Instance 1.
Amount CC. Amount from Subtotal 2. Instance 2.

Line 650. Federal current Scientific Research and Experimental Development limit or federal current Scientific Research and Experimental Development deficit. Amount BB minus amount CC. If the amount on line 650 is positive, enter it on line II in Part 13. If the amount on line 650 is negative, enter it as a positive amount on line DD in Part 12.
Part 11. Amount 1. The corporation's Ontario allocation factor for the tax year that includes its transition time. From line F in Part 6.

Part 11. Amount 2. The greatest of the corporation's Ontario allocation factors for a tax year ending in 2006, 2007, and 2008 as determined under subsection 12(1) of the Corporations Tax Act (Ontario).
Part 11. Amount 3. The greatest of the weighted Ontario allocation factors of the corporation and its designated corporations for 2006, 2007, and 2008.
Line 660. Relevant Ontario allocation factor. The greatest of Part 11 amount 1, Part 11 amount 2, and Part 11 amount 3.
Amount DD. Federal current Scientific Research and Experimental Development deficit for the year. Amount from line 650 in Part 10, if negative. Enter as a positive amount.
Line 670. Scientific Research and Experimental Development expenditure amount deducted in the year under subsection 37(1).
Line 675. Cumulative post-2008 Scientific Research and Experimental Development limit at the end of the year. Amount LL from Part 13.
Amount EE. Subtotal. Line 670 minus line 675. If negative, enter 0. Instance 1.
Amount EE. Amount from Subtotal. Instance 2.
Amount FF. Subtotal. Amount DD plus amount EE.
Amount GG. Amount FF multiplied by 14%.
Amount HH. Post 2008 Scientific Research and Experimental Development balance at the end of the year. Amount GG multiplied by line 660 from Part 11. Enter amount HH on line 460 in Part 7.
Amount II. Federal current Scientific Research and Experimental Development limit for the year. Amount from line 650 in Part 10, if positive.
Line 700. Total of all federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development limits from previous tax years ending after December 31, 2008.
Amount JJ. Subtotal. Line II plus line 700.
Line 705. Total of all amounts deducted under subsection 37(1) for previous tax years ending after December 31, 2008.

Line 710. Total of all transitional tax debits on elected reduced Scientific Research and Experimental Development pool calculated under subsection 48(3) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario) in the previous years. Total of line L in Part 7 for previous years.
Line 715. Amounts included in line 710 that are reasonably attributable to the federal current Scientific Research and Experimental Development deficit for the year.
Line 720. Subtotal. Line 710 minus line 715.
Amount from line 720.
Relevant Ontario allocation factor from line 660 in Part 11 multiplied by 14%.
Amount KK. Amount from line 720 divided by result of Relevant Ontario allocation factor multiplied by 14%.
Line 730. Subtotal. Line 705 minus amount KK. Instance 1.
Line 730. Amount from Subtotal. Instance 2.
Amount LL. Cumulative post-2008 Scientific Research and Experimental Development limit at the end of the year. Amount JJ minus line 730. If negative, enter 0. Enter amount LL on line 675 in Part 12.
Line 735. Amount MM. Amount from line 170 in Part 1. For tax years ending after 2009, enter the amount from line 170 from the 2009 tax year..

Amount NN. Relevant Ontario allocation factor (From line 660. For tax years ending after 2009, enter the amount from the relevant Ontario allocation factor from the 2009 tax year.) multiplied by amount MM.
Amount OO. Amount NN multiplied by 14%. Instance 1.
Amount OO. Amount from result of Amount NN multiplied by 14%. Instance 2.
Line 740. Federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development transitional balance transferred on an eligible amalgamation or an eligible post-2008 winding-up.
Amount PP. Subtotal. Amount OO plus line 740.

Line 750. Total of all transitional tax debits on elected reduced Scientific Research and Experimental Development pool calculated under subsection 48(3) of the Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario) in the previous years. Total of line L in Part 7 for previous years.
Amount QQ. Federal Scientific Research and Experimental Development transitional balance at the end of the year. Amount PP minus line 750. Enter amount QQ on line 470 in Part 7.
